comment: Engine mutation-score floor (caught / viable %, no_tests excluded), enforced nightly by scripts/mutation_gate.py. Re-measured 54.06% on 2026-07-03 (1638 killed + 0 timeout / 3030 viable; 653 no_tests) after harness-enforce-and-deepen Step 7 strengthened tests/unit/test_actions.py: asserting `valid is False` + event game_id/player_id on every action path, plus covering the two branches Step 4 left untested (ASSOCIATION_TARGET_FILTER and the direct-from-hand association source). That killed ~30 load-bearing actions/ survivors, raising the ratio from 50.99% (Step 5) to 54.06% and shrinking no_tests 663->653. Floor RATCHETED 45->50: local timeout=0 kills slow mutants that CI's timeout=85 counts as caught, so CI >= local — a floor below the local 54.06% measurement is safe in CI, with a ~4pp margin. Remaining actions/ survivors are cosmetic error-message-string mutations and state=None no-ops (not load-bearing). Re-measure in CI (mutation.yml workflow_dispatch) to support a further ratchet; lower only behind the harness-change label.
